Here's some examples of what you can find in NirSoft Web site:
- View the passwords stored by your Web browser (Supports Internet Explorer, Firefox, Chrome, Safari, and Opera)
- Extract passwords and other information from router backup file (For supported routers).
: Outlook Express, MS Outlook, Eudora, Mozilla Thunderbird , and more...
Mail PassView - Recover the passwords of popular email clients
- Recovers the passwords of dialup entries (VPN and Internet connections). Works also under Windows 2000/XP.

- 
Freeware utility that recovers the network passwords stored by Windows XP (Credentials file).
- Reveal the passwords hidden behind asterisk ('****') or bullets characters in standard password text-boxes.
WirelessKeyView - Recover lost wireless network key stored on Windows
- Recover the password of Outlook PST file.
- View the details of all wireless network in your area (SSID, Signal Quality, MAC Address, and more...)
- Show who is connected to your wireless network.
- Monitor the Bluetooth activity around you.
- Capture TCP/IP packets on your network adapter and view the captured data as sequence of conversations between clients and servers.
- Freeware tool that displays the list of all currently opened TCP and UDP ports on your local computer.

- displays useful information about your network adapters: IP addresses, Hardware address, WINS servers, DNS servers, MTU value, Number of bytes received or sent, The current transfer speed, and more.
- Test the of your Internet connection.
- View browsing history of your Web browsers (Firefox,Chrome,IE,Edge)
- Find all available information about an IP address: The owner of the IP address, the country/state name, IP addresses range, contact information (address, phone, fax, and email), and more.
- View your latest searches with Google, Yahoo, and MSN.
- Copy video files (.flv and others) from the Web browser cache and temporary folder.
- Take a screenshot of a Web site.
- View the DNS records of specified domains.
- View/Delete/Modify the cookies that Internet Explorer stores on your computer.
- View/Delete the URLs that you visited in the last few days.
- Get information about a registered domain.
- Edit, delete, add, , and records in the AutoComplete files (.NK2) of Outlook.
OutlookAttachView - View and extract attachments of your Outlook mailbox
- Get statistics about your Outlook mailbox.
OutlookAddressBookView - View or export the address book of Outlook
